name: Nero Voice
summary: Local dictation, meeting recordings, timestamped transcripts and editable speaker labels.
capabilities: Records your chosen microphone only after Record or push-to-talk
Transcribes locally with Apple Speech on supported Macs
Copies reviewed text or sends it to a permitted text assistant
Optionally speaks replies using installed system voices
With macOS Accessibility, reads the focused non-password text field and inserts shortcut dictation there
Temporarily uses and restores the clipboard for insertion; never presses Send
Records selected app audio or all system audio only after Start recording in Meetings
Saves meeting audio and bookmarks locally with playback and recovery
Optional 236 MB speaker model download; meeting transcription and speaker analysis run locally after recording
